{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Yahsihan power station''' is an operating power station of at least 927-megawatts (MW) in Kırıkkale, Ankara, Türkiye.
It is also known as Kirikkale CCGT IPP, ACWA Power Kırıkkale Natural Gas.
